text:
tara: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a "precision-fuzz" stage for lowbit canaries to surface brittle FP8/INT8/4-bit regressions before they hit production traffic
anjan: high level? how is fuzz different from our existing synthetic probes?
tara: fuzz focuses on small structural mutations (balanced brackets, unicode-normal forms, numeric jitter, unclosed code fences) and workload-specific grammars (code, math, lists). synthetic probes are more noisy/random
frank: concrete examples: unclosed triple backticks, deeply nested parentheses, emoji clusters, long numeric tables, repeated polite tokens causing repetition hallucinations
oliver: scoring: ops wants a simple decision signal. can we avoid a sprawling composite?
nina: propose two signals combined by max(): (1) drift_score = KL on normalized token probs vs baseline, (2) struct_error_rate = fraction of samples where top-k token sequences diverge beyond threshold. also compute info_drop (mutual info delta) as a tie-breaker
anjan: decision_score = max(drift_norm, struct_norm, info_drop_norm). thresholds: warn >= 0.07, fail >= 0.20. fuzz is aggressive so lower thresholds make sense
frank: runtime hook: runner attaches header `X-Precision-Fuzz: <seed>` and `Fuzz-Profile: <id>` so we can short-circuit batching heuristics and tag telemetry
tara: config example for canary YAML: `fuzz_run: staged`, `fuzz_weight: 0.005`, `fuzz_profile_version: v2`, `fuzz_grammars: [code, math, chat-edge]`, `thresholds: {warn: 0.07, fail: 0.20}`
oliver: cost: estimated 200k tokens/day/model-family at 1% equiv for fuzz. default: run only during staged canaries. Dedicated customers must opt-in to avoid billing surprises
nina: alerting tiers: `fuzz-warning` -> daily digest; `fuzz-fail` -> oncall pager. aggregate per-model-family and dedupe fingerprints to limit noise
anjan: generation approach: grammar + mutator hybrid. grammars produce valid edge-shaped inputs; mutator applies tiny corruptions with deterministic seeds for reproducibility. sample mutator sketch: `def mutate(p): if rand()<0.15: insert_unicode_noise(p); if rand()<0.1: truncate_mid(p); if rand()<0.05: dup_span(p); return p`
frank: important: keep semantic intent for some samples so metrics reflect subtle quality loss, not complete nonsense. also normalize with same tokenizer/preproc as production to avoid false positives
tara: maintenance: quarterly corpus refresh + auto-inject seeds when new failure patterns found in postmortems. add `fuzz_profile_id` field to quant profiles for traceability
nina: artifacts: log mutated input, outputs, token-diff summary to S3, retention default 60d (extendable for enterprise). scrub any customer PII; default corpus must be synthetic
oliver: Dedicated UI: opt-in toggle labelled "Enable precision fuzz canaries (Preview)", show estimated monthly token cost and require tenant consent
anjan: runtime work: integrate into canary-runner as a post-step, plumb header, route telemetry to fuzz pipeline, add `fuzz_profile_id` to canary metadata
ina: alerting UX: allow canary owners to suppress noisy fingerprints for 7/30/90 days; keep a digest channel `#fuzz-warn-digest` and a pager channel `#fuzz-fail-pager`
frank: test plan: run fuzz corpus against known historical FP8 regressions; target to catch >=80% of those as validation before widening rollout
tara: rollout: 1) implement generator + runner hooks this sprint, 2) internal tenants only next week, 3) evaluate signals 2 weeks, 4) widen behind staged flag after validation
deploy-bot: fuzz-canary queued: model-family=small-llama, run=pf-0001, eta=2m :gear:
tara: i'll draft the RFC addendum with schema and example outputs. @anjan take runtime, @frank prototype generator, @nina handle alerting and Dedicated opt-in UI. Thanks all :thumbsup:
